title: Figure 27. Deoxyribozyme-based molecular walker and origami prescriptive landscape
description: Multi-panel figure: (a) the NICK3.4A311 spider with capture leg and 8-17 DNA enzyme legs; (b) the deoxyribozyme cleaving its substrate on an origami surface; (c) spider actions labeled "Start," "Follow," "Turn," and "Stop" after a "TRIGGER strand"; (d) a schematic landscape with positions A–E; and (e) an origami landscape with a 25 nm scale. Captioned "Figure 27. Deoxyribozyme-based molecular walker and origami prescriptive landscape." Text below begins the "Discussion" section on quantum computing timelines.
